preliminary_note: Early numerical prototypes and pre-final plan/telemetry observations are retained. auto-final cases validate carried plans after the nested-scope fix. Initial scale cases predate the final uniform-scaling norm shortcut and telemetry/planning changes; the dimensional compression/refinement algorithm is the same.
timing_exclusion: Only the known environment-reconnect-spanning baseline is excluded. Other first runs and outliers remain.
source_hashes: Later runs record the hash of all backend Python sources at process start. The final live-capacity planning correction changes that aggregate hash but is not used by explicitly compressed timing runs.
prototype_policy: coarse_blas, parallel_solve, dense_extra_refinement and tile_extra_refinement are audit-only hooks, never imported by production. compression_only disables scaled refinement as a causal control.
